title: Guidance gap: Kimi discovery mapping is undocumented
symptom: A Kimi user is not told which installer host mapping installs the discovered skill
trigger: Read the Host use section and walkthrough as a Kimi Code CLI user
expected: Guidance states that Kimi Code CLI discovers the .agents skill installed by the openai mapping
actual: Kimi discovered .agents automatically, but the docs list other host values and never explain that mapping
impact: Cold discovery works, but a Kimi user cannot reproduce the installation from the docs without guessing

notes.text: The original Kimi cold-start observation supplies failed evidence for this finding; its recorded scope and open status are unchanged
The retrospective scope-gate observation preserves the same original failure on the completed draft content; scope and open status are unchanged
